description:
Adds a work experience record to the user's GigHQ profile.

Confirm the company, role, dates, and whether the role is current with the user before saving. start_year and current are required. end_year is required when current is false.

This creates a new record each time it is called — do not retry blindly. Use list_experiences or get_profile to review existing roles first.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

current.description: Whether this is the user's current role.

employment_type.description: Employment type: full_time, part_time, contract, volunteer, internship, or numeric id 1–5.

end_year.description: End year. Required when current is false.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: add_experience
title: Add work experience
